The '''subjugation''' of [[Charis]] occurred in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Charis, located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], was under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule during the conflict between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In 4 ABY, the population of Charis [[Charis uprising|rebelled]] and tried to overthrow their Imperial oppressors. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], ruler of the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]], ordered a brutal assault, which [[Death/Legends|reduced the population]] of the planet from 1 billion inhabitants to 850 million and ruined several major [[City/Legends|cities]].

==Prelude==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Charis]], located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], was part of the territory ruled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].<ref name="TDC" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the population staged a [[Charis uprising|violent uprising]] against the Imperial forces on the planet.<ref name="TDC" />

==The subjugation==
Moff Sarne's reaction to the uprising was swift and violent. [[Starship/Legends|Ships]] from his [[Moff Sarne's forces|military forces]], including the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[FarStar|''Renegade'']], attacked the planet. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the assault was finished and the uprising had been quelled, many of Charis's foremost [[City/Legends|cities]] had been devastated and reduced to bombed-out ruins. The [[Death/Legends|death]] toll was massive&mdash;approximately 150 million beings had been killed in the subjugation, reducing the population of the planet from one billion to 850 million.<ref name="TDC" />

==Aftermath==
[[8 ABY/Legends|Four years later]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] successfully [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] Moff Sarne's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], forcing the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] into retreat into the depths of the sector. With the New Republic beginning to spread its influence throughout the region, insurgents and New Republic sympathizers prepared to stage a second uprising to throw off their Imperial oppressors. However, mindful of the devastation that had been visited on them four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] previously, they wanted support from the New Republic before acting.<ref name="TDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The subjugation of Charis was mentioned in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', an [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]] as background information regarding the history of the sector. The information on Charis appeared in the section "Kathol Sector Overview," written by [[Bill Smith]].<ref name="TDC" />
